# CORDIS — Community Research and Development Information Service

> CORDIS is the European Commission's primary public repository for results of
> EU-funded research and innovation projects (Framework Programmes FP1 through
> Horizon Europe), online since November 1994 — the first website launched by
> the European institutions. As of 2025, CORDIS indexes more than 150,000
> projects across all framework programmes from FP1 (1984) to Horizon Europe
> (2021–2027), with 13+ million annual visits. Operated by the Publications
> Office of the European Union, Unit C.4 "CORDIS and Research Result Services".
> Editorial content owned by the EU is licensed under Creative Commons
> Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) per Commission Decision
> 2011/833/EU. Beneficiary-supplied materials (deliverables, publications,
> reports) follow the terms of their respective Grant Agreements and are NOT
> covered by CC BY 4.0. For bulk and structured access, prefer the SPARQL
> endpoint (EURIO Knowledge Graph) and data.europa.eu. Project factsheet pages
> contain personal data of researchers protected by Regulation (EU) 2018/1725.

Attribution format for CC BY 4.0 content: "European Union, CORDIS —
https://cordis.europa.eu — CC BY 4.0". This file last reviewed: 2026-05.

## About CORDIS

- [About CORDIS](https://cordis.europa.eu/about): mission, governance, scope, and history of the service since 1990; operated by Publications Office Unit C.4
- [Content types explained](https://cordis.europa.eu/about/content): factsheets, deliverables, publications, Results in Brief, Thematic Packs — what each content type contains
- [Services overview](https://cordis.europa.eu/about/services): RSS feeds, SPARQL endpoint, REST API, widgets, eTranslation
- [Legal notice and reuse policy](https://cordis.europa.eu/about/legal): full copyright statement, CC BY 4.0 scope, beneficiary content licensing rules, attribution instructions
- [FAQ](https://cordis.europa.eu/about/faq): common questions about how to search projects, understand results, and access data
- [Search syntax reference](https://cordis.europa.eu/about/search): XPath query operators and field references for the CORDIS search engine
- [SPARQL and Linked Open Data documentation](https://cordis.europa.eu/about/sparql): EURIO ontology documentation, query examples, federated query support
- [Data extraction REST API documentation](https://cordis.europa.eu/about/dataextractions-api): authenticated API (EU Login) for bulk extraction

## Framework Programmes

Programme pages document EU funding instruments. URL pattern: `https://cordis.europa.eu/programme/id/{CODE}`. Sub-programme calls follow `https://cordis.europa.eu/programme/id/{FRAMEWORK}_{CALL_CODE}` (e.g. `HORIZON_HORIZON-EIC-2025-PATHFINDEROPEN`).

- [Horizon Europe (2021–2027)](https://cordis.europa.eu/programme/id/HORIZON): ninth EU framework programme for research and innovation; budget ≈ €95.5 billion; three pillars (Excellent Science, Global Challenges, Innovative Europe); legal basis: Regulation (EU) 2021/695
- [Horizon 2020 (2014–2020)](https://cordis.europa.eu/programme/id/H2020): eighth framework programme; budget ≈ €80 billion; 35,386 funded projects; Societal Challenges structure
- [FP7 (2007–2013)](https://cordis.europa.eu/programme/id/FP7): seventh framework programme; budget ≈ €50.5 billion; 25,785 projects; introduced ERC and individual grants
- [FP6 (2002–2006)](https://cordis.europa.eu/programme/id/FP6): sixth framework programme; budget ≈ €17.5 billion; Networks of Excellence and Integrated Projects
- [European Innovation Council (EIC)](https://cordis.europa.eu/programme/id/HORIZON.3.1): Pillar 3 of Horizon Europe; EIC Pathfinder, EIC Transition, EIC Accelerator
- [Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA)](https://cordis.europa.eu/programme/id/HORIZON.1.2): Pillar 1; researcher mobility grants at all career stages
- [European Research Council (ERC)](https://cordis.europa.eu/programme/id/HORIZON.1.1): Pillar 1; frontier research grants (Starting, Consolidator, Advanced, Synergy, PoC)
- [EU Missions under Horizon Europe](https://cordis.europa.eu/programme/id/HORIZON.2): five missions — Cancer, Climate Adaptation, Ocean, Smart Cities, Soil
- [Euratom Research and Training (2021–2025)](https://cordis.europa.eu/programme/id/EURATOM-2021): nuclear research complementary to Horizon Europe

## Projects and Results

Project factsheet URL pattern: `https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/{GRANT_AGREEMENT_ID}`
Project results URL pattern: `https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/{ID}/results` — NOTE: results pages may include third-party deliverables under non-CC licences. For bulk programmatic access prefer the SPARQL endpoint or data.europa.eu datasets.

- [All projects search](https://cordis.europa.eu/projects): entry point to search across 150,000+ projects by keyword, country, framework programme, status, and topic
- [Horizon Europe projects](https://cordis.europa.eu/search?q=contenttype%3D%27project%27%20AND%20frameworkProgramme%3D%27HORIZON%27): filter to active framework 2021–2027
- [Horizon 2020 projects](https://cordis.europa.eu/search?q=contenttype%3D%27project%27%20AND%20frameworkProgramme%3D%27H2020%27): 35,386 projects
- [FP7 projects](https://cordis.europa.eu/search?q=contenttype%3D%27project%27%20AND%20frameworkProgramme%3D%27FP7%27): 25,785 projects
- Project sitemaps (machine-readable inventory): `https://cordis.europa.eu/project_sitemap_en_1.xml` through `project_sitemap_en_7.xml` for English; `project_sitemap_{lang}.xml` for translated versions

## Editorial Content — News, Articles and Results in Brief (CC BY 4.0)

Article URL pattern: `https://cordis.europa.eu/article/id/{ID}-{slug}`. Content types: news, brief (Results in Brief), resultsPack, interview.

- [News (CORDIS Wire)](https://cordis.europa.eu/news): daily science and policy news drawn from EU research results; original editorial content authored by CORDIS Editorial Team
- [Results in Brief](https://cordis.europa.eu/results-in-brief): curated summaries of project outcomes; highest-density informational content on the site, written for non-specialist readers; translated to a subset of the 24 official EU languages, with coverage varying by article
- [Articles index](https://cordis.europa.eu/articles): complete article catalogue across all editorial types
- News sitemaps: `https://cordis.europa.eu/news_sitemap_{lang}.xml` (en/es/de/fr/it/pl) and `https://cordis.europa.eu/news_sitemap_multi.xml` for all 24 EU languages
- Results in Brief sitemaps: `https://cordis.europa.eu/results_in_brief_sitemap_{lang}.xml` and `https://cordis.europa.eu/results_in_brief_sitemap_multi.xml`
- Article sitemap: `https://cordis.europa.eu/article_sitemap_{lang}.xml` and `https://cordis.europa.eu/article_sitemap_multi.xml`

## Thematic Packs

- [Thematic Packs landing](https://cordis.europa.eu/thematic-packs): curated multilingual collections grouping projects, results and analysis by topic
- Three sub-types: **Results Packs** (project outcome anthologies on a single theme), **Info Packs** (background dossiers on policy areas), **Synergy Packs** (cross-programme collections)
- Sitemap: `https://cordis.europa.eu/thematic_packs_sitemap_{lang}.xml` and `thematic_packs_sitemap_multi.xml`

## CORDIScovery Podcast

CORDIS produces the CORDIScovery podcast: science communication episodes featuring project coordinators, researchers, and policy experts discussing EU-funded science.

- [CORDIScovery podcast landing](https://cordis.europa.eu/videos-podcasts): episode index, transcripts and embedded players
- Sitemap: `https://cordis.europa.eu/podcast_sitemap_{lang}.xml` (en/es/de/fr/it/pl)

## Videos

Short-form video content: project highlights, interviews, animated explainers.

- [Videos landing](https://cordis.europa.eu/videos-podcasts): video index with descriptions and project links
- Sitemap: `https://cordis.europa.eu/video_sitemap_{lang}.xml` (en/es/de/fr/it/pl)


## Open Data, APIs and Linked Open Data

- [Datavis](https://cordis.europa.eu/datalab/visualisations): interactive visualisations, dashboards, network analysis over the full CORDIS dataset
- [SPARQL endpoint (EURIO Knowledge Graph)](https://cordis.europa.eu/datalab/sparql-endpoint): linked open data; SPARQL 1.1; federated queries; per-record licensing metadata; ontology aligned with schema.org, FRAPO, DINGO, W3C Org Ontology
- [EURIO ontology specification](https://op.europa.eu/en/web/eu-vocabularies/eurio): OWL 2 ontology for EU research information; canonical URI prefix `https://w3id.org/eurio/`
- [EuroSciVoc taxonomy](https://op.europa.eu/en/web/eu-vocabularies/euroscivoc): multilingual science classification (DE/EN/ES/FR/IT/PL) based on OECD Frascati; used to tag all CORDIS projects
- [CORDIS bulk datasets on data.europa.eu](https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets?query=CORDIS&publisher=Publications+Office+of+the+European+Union): preferred channel for large-scale reuse; CC0 metadata + CC BY 4.0 text
- [Horizon Europe bulk dataset](https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets/cordis-eu-research-projects-under-horizon-europe-2021-2027): formats RDF/TTL/N-Quads/JSONLD/N-Triples + XML/CSV/JSON/XLS
- [Horizon 2020 bulk dataset](https://data.europa.eu/88u/dataset/cordisH2020projects)
- [FP7 bulk dataset](https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets/cordisfp7projects)
- [Sitemap index (machine-readable site inventory)](https://cordis.europa.eu/sitemapindex.xml): complete list of all sitemaps grouped by content type and language

## Multilingual Coverage

CORDIS publishes editorial content (News, Results in Brief, Thematic Packs, About pages) in **6 native interface languages** and translates Results in Brief to a subset of the 24 official EU languages, with coverage varying by article.

- **URL pattern:** language is appended as a suffix to any path: `{path}/{lang_code}` — example: `https://cordis.europa.eu/article/id/454264-cordis-30-years/it`
- **Canonical (English, no suffix):** https://cordis.europa.eu
- **6 native interface languages:**
  - English (default, canonical): https://cordis.europa.eu
  - Spanish: https://cordis.europa.eu/es
  - German: https://cordis.europa.eu/de
  - French: https://cordis.europa.eu/fr
  - Italian: https://cordis.europa.eu/it
  - Polish: https://cordis.europa.eu/pl
- **Extended translations** (Results in Brief, selected articles): bg, cs, da, el, et, fi, ga, hr, hu, lt, lv, mt, nl, pt, ro, sk, sl, sv — plus partner-country languages no (Norwegian), sr (Serbian), tr (Turkish)
- **Scientific content** (project objectives, deliverables, periodic reports, programme pages) is mostly English-only
- **eTranslation** provides on-demand machine translation in all 24 official EU languages for any page
- **Multilingual sitemaps:** the `*_sitemap_multi.xml` variants enumerate every language version of each editorial item — useful for crawlers building hreflang maps

## Notes for AI Providers and Agents

- **Licensing scope:** CC BY 4.0 covers editorial content authored by CORDIS (News, Results in Brief, Thematic Packs, About pages, Programme pages, podcast and video descriptions). It does NOT cover deliverables or publications uploaded by project beneficiaries — those follow per-project Grant Agreement terms.
- **Personal data:** project factsheets include names and contact details of principal investigators and project officers, protected by Regulation (EU) 2018/1725 (EUDPR). Processing this personal data requires a separate legal basis independent of copyright.
- **Attribution format:** "European Union, CORDIS — https://cordis.europa.eu — CC BY 4.0"
- **Preferred access for agents:** use the SPARQL endpoint or bulk datasets on data.europa.eu for large-scale or automated access; individual page scraping at scale is discouraged and covered by Crawl-delay in robots.txt.
- **robots.txt:** https://cordis.europa.eu/robots.txt — all crawlers are permitted via `User-agent: *`; restricted paths include `/search?`, `/data/`, `/mailanon/`, and file formats `format=xml` / `format=pdf` within `/rcn/` and `/id/` directories.
- **Sitemaps:** https://cordis.europa.eu/sitemapindex.xml lists all content sitemaps by type and language.
- **AI Act compliance:** this file and robots.txt are provided as machine-readable signals per Article 53(1)(c) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), applicable to GPAI providers from 2 August 2025.

## Optional

- [Archives and legacy publications](https://cordis.europa.eu/about/archives): Research*eu magazine archive (2004–2020), historical FP publications
- [Explainability of AI classification (EuroSciVoc)](https://cordis.europa.eu/about/explainability): methodology behind automated topic tagging of projects
- [Accessibility statement](https://cordis.europa.eu/about/accessibility): WCAG 2.1 AA conformance declaration
